$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFBD (AIP France, chart dated 2026-09-03): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Bordeaux - Mérignac

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

service.atsHours: H24 - Aéroport de BORDEAUX Mérignac - BP 70116 - 33704 Mérignac Cedex (UTC HIV ; HOR ETE : -1HR)

notes: Compulsory Airport handling service: see TXT 03 Engine tests should have been carried out before taxiing request.
Areas K/J: Aircraft departing under VFR flight rules also contact ATC to request startup clearance, which may include a taxi hold, before leaving their parking position or the refueling station.
From 1st APR to 31st OCT, due to ACFT stands congestion, obtaining a stand is subject to a request before the departure, to the AD operator SA-ADBM via the ground handling company.
This procedure does not apply to based ACFT, State ACFT and HEMS.
Gliders and ULM prohibited within the CTR.
Training flights are under restriction (see AIP: AD 2 LFBD.21.4.1.3).
Air navigation hazard Confusion risk between thresholds 05 and 11 due to their proximity.
Paradropping activity NR 312: see AIP ENR 5.5 AEM activity NR 9011, 9026, 9380 and 9497: see AIP ENR 5.5 Free flying winch launch activity NR 905: see AIP ENR 5.5 special VFR conditions.
VMC environmental protection respect.
These routes are two-way, usable for departures, arrivals and transits.
Except particular clearance: an overfly altitude of 1500 ft AMSL will be respected on all routes (except the exit by SW, cf. § ‘'Departing procedures'').

Transit within AQUITAINE FIS Flight information service given on frequency AQUITAINE Information to VFR flights inside class E and G relevant from AQUITAINE FIS can be interrupted without any forecast.
In that case each class D airspace transit must be cleared on AQUITAINE Approach frequencies sector BW on 129.880 or BE on 119.275.
* All tracks are two-way Arrival procedures Aircraft bound to LFBD and operating in uncontrolled airspace must call MERIGNAC TWR, 3 minutes before overflying of entry points.
Vacating via inactive RWY: is considered as effective as soon as the ACFT crosses wildlife control way.
It is subject to ATC clearance.
It is prohibited by night or during daytime when RVR is smaller than 800 m.
Departing procedures For flights to SW: due to the TMA 1.1 presence whose lower limit is 1000 ft AMSL, the default exit point is point S.
Exit via SW is possible on request and ATC clearance only and at the altitude given by ATC.
In addition, pilots must be aware of le Barp LF P 5 area proximity.
It is necessary to adapt the navigation accordingly.
Niveau / Level 8.
Voir / see AIP AD 2 LFBD.6 Péril animalier / Wildlife strike hazard: de / from SR-30 à / to SS+30.
